name: FinTech & Capital Markets
description: Specialized terminology for banking, DeFi, high-frequency trading, and corporate finance.

entries.domain_definition: The property of a good or commodity whose individual units are capable of mutual substitution.
The simultaneous purchase and sale of equivalent assets in different markets to exploit price discrepancies.
The ease with which an asset can be converted into ready cash without affecting its market price.
The act of pledging an asset to a lender to secure repayment of a loan or financial obligation.
Financial contracts whose value is dependent upon or derived from an underlying asset or group of assets.
The economic incentives, monetary policy, and distribution design governing a digital cryptocurrency token.
The ability of an enterprise to meet its long-term financial commitments and obligations.
The financial practice of pooling various contractual debts and packaging them into interest-bearing securities.
The scheduled gradual reduction of a debt obligation over time through regular periodic payments.
The price discrepancy between the expected price of a trade and the actual execution price.
